dataset.name: LoCoMo
dataset.paper: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents, ACL 2024
dataset.independence: different dataset authors, conversations, domain distribution, and annotations; no aligned MedMemoryBench examples

adapter.arrival_order: chronological session number then turn order
adapter.query_cutoff: end of the complete released conversation

adapter.exclusion: QA records without dialog-level evidence; these are not retrieval-grounded
